title: Pet Tear Stain Cleaning Pads

Lurson Pet Tear Stain Cleaning Cotton Pads | Gentle Eye Cleaning & Grooming for Dogs & Cats | 2-in-1 Formula | 80 Count

  • Soft and non-irritating formula to gently wipe away tear residue, dirt and debris around the eyes
